title: Narra 4.1.31 — smoother playback
message: Install 4.1.31 over Narra 4.1.30 to keep your library and downloads. This update refreshes the anime player and TV layout, improves sign-in messages, and makes ad controls clearer.
changelog: Update over 4.1.30 without uninstalling to keep local downloads and settings.
The anime player and landscape episode guide use a more compact layout with episode titles and 50-episode pages.
The TV anime interface has a refreshed remote-friendly layout.
Account restoration and sign-in errors are clearer, including email verification guidance.
A skipped real ad no longer triggers a second fallback ad, and the fallback's close and donation controls are easier to see.
